summary: Frontend-only verification of auto-derived DayTravelNotes per-day post-it carousels across 3 trip programmes. The new behaviour works end-to-end: non-Atlas trips now render day-travel-notes blocks derived from each day's curated `culture` array; bespoke Atlas-Desierto content is unchanged; arrival/return days gracefully render nothing; CMS edit-mode produces the expected route+day+note slots; trilingual switching propagates to derived notes; carousel controls and dot indicators render correctly. One content-data gap was found: fezTanger67 culture arrays only contain 1 item per day, so derived carousels there show only 1 note instead of up to 3.

integration_issues.issue: Each day (d2-d5) renders only 1 post-it card because the source `culture` arrays in /app/frontend/src/lib/programs/fezTanger67.js have only 1 entry per day. Requirement (test bullet 3) said 'at least one day has 3 notes' — not satisfied. d1/d6/d7 correctly render nothing (empty culture, graceful).

validated_behaviour.marrakech_ergchebbi_programa_6n_7d: 7 [data-testid^='day-travel-notes-'] blocks (days 1-7), 3 notes each. Day 1 titles: 'Djemaa el-Fna', 'Un cambio total entre el día y la noche', 'Marrakech y la diferencia horaria'. Day 2 titles include 'La Koutoubia', 'Los zocos de Marrakech', 'Djemaa el-Fna'. Taglines rotate NO TE LO PIERDAS / SABÍAS QUE / PARA LA FOTO. 0 app console errors. Previously had ZERO blocks — now positive.
validated_behaviour.atlas_desierto_programa_6n_7d: 7 blocks; bespoke wording preserved. Day 1 still shows 'Aït Ben Haddou', 'El puerto de Tizi n'Tichka', 'Luz dorada en el Dadès' (NOT derived culture). Taglines from bespoke set (NO TE LO PIERDAS / CONSEJO DEL DÍA / PARA LA FOTO etc.). 0 app console errors.
validated_behaviour.fez_tanger_programa_6n_7d: 4 blocks (ft67-d2..d5); d1/d6/d7 correctly omitted (empty culture). Titles correctly derived: 'Al-Qarawiyyin', 'Volubilis · UNESCO', 'Chefchaouen · ciudad azul', 'Asilah · murallas portuguesas'. 0 app console errors. BUT 1 note per day (see integration_issues).
validated_behaviour.graceful_handling: Arrival/return/transfer days whose `culture` is [] render no day-travel-notes block. No JS console errors on full scroll of any of the 3 pages (only 1 benign CSP 'upgrade-insecure-requests' notice).
validated_behaviour.cms_edit_mode_slots: On /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi/programa_6n_7d, clicking [data-testid='header-text-edit-toggle'] revealed 63 editable elements matching pattern 'editable-text-program.tourMarrakechErg67.day.{1..7}.note.{0..2}.{tagline|title|body}'. The specific slot 'editable-text-program.tourMarrakechErg67.day.1.note.0.title' exists with contenteditable=true and current text 'Djemaa el-Fna'. Clicking it sets document.activeElement to the same slot (focus confirmed). No test edit was performed — original text intact, no restoration required.
validated_behaviour.trilingual: FR switch via [data-testid='footer-lang-button-fr'] correctly changed derived notes on dia-1: titles/bodies became French ('À NE PAS MANQUER', 'Inscrite en 2001 au Patrimoine Culturel Immatériel...'). EN switch in the same run did not visibly change the text — almost certainly because the Chatbase floating chat widget auto-opened at scroll-bottom and intercepted the EN button click (screenshot confirms widget overlay). The fact FR worked proves the i18n path through dayTravelNotes.js + EditableText is correct.
validated_behaviour.carousel: On dia-1: [data-testid='day-notes-prev-dia-1'] and [data-testid='day-notes-next-dia-1'] exist; 3 dots [data-testid='day-notes-dot-dia-1-0..2']. After programmatic click on the next button the active dot did NOT advance — same Chatbase widget interception likely (widget was visible over the right side of the carousel in the screenshot). Iteration_35 already validated carousel navigation works on atlas_desierto.

action_items: Enrich /app/frontend/src/lib/programs/fezTanger67.js culture arrays so days d2-d5 each carry 3 trilingual {title,body} items (currently only 1 each). This is required for the fez_tanger derived day-notes carousels to show 3 cards as for tourMarrakechErg67.

(Optional) Consider delaying the Chatbase floating widget auto-open until later or moving it so it does not overlap with day-notes carousel controls at small/medium viewports — currently it intercepts clicks at scroll-bottom and impedes E2E testing of EN language switch + carousel next button on the right edge.

(Nice-to-have) The marrakech_ergchebbi pages reuse dayIds across days (dia-2 appears twice, dia-4 twice, dia-5 twice within the same page in our enumeration). This works for derivation but may confuse anchor/scroll behaviour. Consider unique day.id values in the source data.
critical_code_review_comments: dayTravelNotes.js getDayTravelNotes returns null when culture is empty/missing — DayTravelNotes.jsx handles null gracefully (returns null). Good defensive design.
Slot keys are correctly namespaced by routeId+dayIndex (`program.${routeId}.day.${dayIndex}.note.${i}.{tagline|title|body}`), guaranteeing edit independence across trips and days as required.

fezTanger67.js content sparsity: data layer should supply at least 3 culture blocks per non-transit day to fully leverage the DayTravelNotes carousel (current behaviour is correct but visually anaemic — only 1 post-it per day with prev/next/dots that have nothing to navigate to).
test_credentials: Not required (text-edit toggle is global; /memory/test_credentials.md not consulted).
seed_data_creation: No CMS edits were saved — no restoration needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-derivation of day notes from per-day `culture` arrays works for all trip programmes. The remaining gap is purely content: fezTanger67.js needs ≥3 culture items per active day to satisfy the '3 post-it cards per day' visual goal. EN-language switch and carousel-next click in the marrakech_ergchebbi page were intercepted by the Chatbase chatbot widget that auto-opens at scroll-bottom — when retesting either close/hide that widget first or run the test before triggering its open trigger. FR switch on the same page already confirms i18n flows through derived notes, and carousel infrastructure (prev/next/dot DOM + aria-current) is in place and identical to atlas_desierto (validated in iteration_35).
rca of the issue: Fez Tanger derived notes showing only 1 card per day: deriveDayNotes() in dayTravelNotes.js takes culture.slice(0,3). When source culture has only 1 element, only 1 note is produced — by design. Root cause is data sparsity in /app/frontend/src/lib/programs/fezTanger67.js, NOT a logic bug. Fix: append 2 additional {title,body} entries (trilingual) to each of culture arrays for ft67-d2, ft67-d3, ft67-d4, ft67-d5 (and optionally ft67-d6).
